subject: Future Tech
title: Speed Breakthroughs
description: A micro-lesson that makes Speed Breakthroughs usable.

hook.text: 3D printing's biggest weakness has been speed. A small part can take hours.

buildup.text: Carbon's CLIP technology uses oxygen and light to cure resin continuously instead of layer by layer.

discovery.text: HP's Multi Jet Fusion prints full powder layers at once using inkjet heads, making parts in minutes instead of hours.

twist.text: MIT researchers built a printer extruding thermoplastic 10x faster than FDM without losing accuracy.

climax.text: As speed increases, 3D printing shifts from prototyping to mass production.

punchline.text: Fast enough to prototype was just the start.

quiz.question: How much faster is Carbon's CLIP technology compared to traditional methods?
